decision_clause: The active decision, scoped to `gitseed/ports.py`, ruled out “scoring and screening ports” because both are pure deterministic domain functions with no outside capability to supply.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: If evidence extraction cannot run or raises an exception, execution creates an empty, ABSENT evidence item for every name advertised by the configured evidence reader and records a category-read failure. Scoring and screening remain directly invoked domain computations; no externally supplied scoring or screening capability is exposed through the run ports.
rationale: The finished `RunPorts` exposes repository, file, model, clock, and evidence readers, but no scoring or screening port. The change only consults the already-configurable evidence reader for its advertised vocabulary when constructing degraded category evidence. It neither modifies the scoped `gitseed/ports.py` nor introduces an indirect externally supplied scoring or screening implementation, so it clearly stays outside the ruled-out approach.
